findings.body:
Gain 5, Work 1, Harm 3
Raise: Not done
Case: normal use - running this repository after the release.
The release tests require the repository pin to be v1.2.37, but forge.toml:2 still pins v1.2.36. All three named version-and-pin tests therefore contain assertions that cannot pass. State-changing commands also hand off to the older release, as shown in src/forge/repo.py:978 and src/forge/repo.py:1005. The changed .forge/hooks.sh and .github/workflows/forge.yml say v1.2.37 even though their generators use the repository pin (src/forge/sync.py:109 and src/forge/prcheck.py:392), so they are not synced to its current configuration. Update the pin, sync the generated files, and rerun the release tests.
